posts.hook: AI is now the one knocking on government servers
posts.caption: ai agents aimed sql injection at government sites, meta's muse keeps a page on everyone in your life, apple and google lobby states on age checks. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: AI agents aimed ==SQL injection== at US and Canadian government sites
slides.desc: Automated agents probing public-sector targets is now a reported case, not a forecast.

terms.gloss: typing malicious database commands into a web form

slides.title: Meta's Muse compiles a page for every person in your life
slides.desc: Prompts show facts and relationship tips kept on people who never installed it.

terms.gloss: meta's ai agent, downloaded by millions

slides.title: Apple and Google pitch state age-check bills; Meta wants app stores to verify
slides.desc: Who has to verify ages, and who can be sued, is the real fight.

slides.title: Altman says OpenAI and Anthropic still disagree on regulation
slides.desc: He argues AI's benefits justify accepting some risks.

slides.title: Anthropic's charity stock match hit ==$660M+== in six months
slides.desc: It is likely to reach billions after the IPO, diluting shareholders.

slides.title: Cloudflare is building a free public CA to rival Let's Encrypt
slides.desc: A second large free issuer of HTTPS certificates.

terms.gloss: the body that issues the certificates behind https
the nonprofit that issues free https certificates

posts.hook: The Pentagon has reportedly gone quiet on Claude
posts.caption: the pentagon has reportedly stopped using anthropic's tools, chatgpt is getting visual ads, norway wants ai glasses banned in public places. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: The DOD has stopped using Anthropic's tools, an official says
slides.desc: Sources say Claude was still in use as recently as last week.

terms.gloss: the us department of defense, the pentagon

slides.title: ChatGPT will test ==visual ads== beside generated images
slides.desc: Sponsored images start in the US this month; OpenAI says answers stay unaffected.

slides.title: Norway proposes a temporary ban on AI glasses in parks, beaches and schools
slides.desc: First major country to move on filming without people's knowledge.

slides.title: Denmark's CPR registry reports unauthorized access to citizens' data
slides.desc: The headline figure is 8.8M people exposed.

terms.gloss: denmark's national registry of every resident's personal data

slides.title: Only ==11%== of businesses could forecast their AI spending
slides.desc: Cheaper models cost more than pricier ones on 32% of tasks Microsoft tested.

slides.title: Google pauses its open source bug bounty over AI slop
slides.desc: Most automated submissions were invalid; arXiv also rate-limited papers.
